Wandstärke, Nordrichtung, Wetter, Favori: Wall thickness, north, weather, favourites and your own buttons: with the settings you fit NeonPlan 3D to your home.
In dieser Folge gehe ich jede Einstellun: In this episode I go through every setting with you.
Folge 12 ist die letzte Folge der Reihe: Episode 12 is the last episode of the series and has two parts. Part 1 is about all the settings in the editor.
Teil 2 zeigt Sicherung, Umzug auf ein ne: Part 2 shows backups, moving to a new Home Assistant, and which data NeonPlan stores. Once again I use the demo house from the online demo.
Alles findest du im Reiter „Editor“. Obe: You find everything in the Editor tab. At the top I switch on “3D beside” – in German „3D daneben“ – so you see every change in 3D right away.
Rechts in der Seitenleiste stehen ganz u: At the very bottom of the sidebar on the right there are sections that fold open: Start view, Favourites, the Template, Settings – „Einstellungen“ – and Backup – „Sicherung“.
Alles hier gilt für den ganzen Plan – al: Everything here applies to the whole plan – so also to the dashboard card, the kiosk and every wall tablet.
Ich klappe „Einstellungen“ auf. Ganz obe: I open Settings. At the top are the thicknesses for all walls: exterior wall and interior wall – „Außenwand“ and „Innenwand“ – in metres.
Das Demo-Haus hat außen 24 Zentimeter. I: The demo house has 24 centimetres outside. I make it 36 – on the right, every exterior wall gets thicker at once.
Eine einzelne Wand stellst du dagegen am: A single wall, on the other hand, you set at its room, in the wall heights box with its thickness – that was in episode 2. I go back to 24.
„Raster“ ist die Schrittweite beim Zeich: Grid – „Raster“ – is the step size for drawing: corners snap to this grid, in the demo house every 5 centimetres.
Auch die Pfeiltasten schieben das Ausgew: The arrow keys also move the selection by one grid step – with Shift by 10 and with Alt by one centimetre.
Mein Tipp: Lass das Raster fein. Mit ein: My tip: keep the grid fine. With half a metre you will hardly hit a real measurement when you trace a plan.
Darunter die „Nordrichtung“: Wie viele G: Below that is North – „Nordrichtung“: how many degrees clockwise from the top of the plan is north?
Die braucht NeonPlan für die Sonne: Aus: NeonPlan needs it for the sun: from the sun's position in Home Assistant, light falls through the windows that face the sun.
Zeigt bei dir oben im Plan nach Westen,: If the top of your plan points west, you enter 90 – a map app helps you find the direction.
Fällt die Sonne durch die falschen Fenst: If the sun comes through the wrong windows, this number is almost always wrong. I set it back to 0.
Ganz unten im Abschnitt steht „Sonnenlic: At the bottom of the section is “Sunlight through the windows” – „Sonnenlicht durch die Fenster“. Without the tick the floor stays free of sun patches.
Heruntergelassene Rollläden machen die F: By the way, closed blinds make the patches smaller, just like in real life.
Dann das „Dach“. Hier steht das einfache: Then the roof – „Dach“. Here is the simple roof for the whole house: no roof, flat roof, gable roof – or custom roof sections, „Dachflächen (frei)“.
Beim Satteldach legt „First“ fest, ob de: For a gable roof, Ridge – „First“ – sets whether the ridge runs along the long or the short side – the short one is typical for a terraced house.
Dazu kommen „Dachneigung“ in Grad und „D: Then roof pitch in degrees and roof overhang in metres. I set 45 degrees and take a look in the 3D tab.
Das Dach ist jetzt deutlich steiler. Zur: The roof is much steeper now. Back in the editor I set it to 35 degrees again.
„Dachflächen (frei)“ baut das Dach aus m: Custom roof sections build the roof from several parts, with hips, dormers and roof windows – episodes 7 and 8 show that.
Weiter mit dem Wetter. Unter „Wetter-Ent: On to the weather. Under weather entity – „Wetter-Entität“ – you choose where it comes from. Automatic takes the first weather entity in Home Assistant.
Darunter die „Wetter-Effekte in 3D“: Reg: Below are the weather effects in 3D: rain, snow, fog, clouds, lightning, sun and moon. You can switch off each effect on its own.
Nebel ist anfangs aus, weil er die ganze: Fog is off at first, because it greys the whole scene. On the Tablet quality level only the dimming by clouds remains.
Das Wetter rund ums Haus bringt die Pro-: The weather around the house comes with the Pro add-on Weather outside. The warning below it is free.
„Warnung: Fenster offen bei Regen“: Meld: “Warning: window open while it rains”: if the weather entity reports rain and a window is open, the room pulses red. If you don't need it, untick it here.
Weiter oben die „Startansicht“: Du drehs: Further up is the start view: you turn the house on the right the way it should open, and press “Remember the current 3D view as the start”.
Das gilt für die 3D-Ansicht, die Karte u: That applies to the 3D view, the card and the kiosk; Default – „Standard“ – takes it back. Episode 10 shows start views for floors and rooms.
Unter „Favoriten“ legst du fest, was im: Under Favourites – „Favoriten“ – you set what is in the star of the 3D view: scenes, scripts, automations, buttons and switches.
Typisch sind Party, Anwesenheitssimulati: Typical ones are party mode, presence simulation, shading or watering the garden.
In „Favorit hinzufügen“ tippst du einfac: In “Add a favourite” you just start typing and pick the match. I take the script “Living room all off”.
Die Pfeile ändern die Reihenfolge, das K: The arrows change the order, the cross removes a favourite again.
Darunter stehen die „Eigenen Knöpfe“ – i: Below are your own buttons – „Eigene Knöpfe“ – in the star they appear below the favourites. “+ Own button” adds a new one.
Er bekommt eine „Beschriftung“ und eine: It gets a label and an action. “Open a path” – „Seite öffnen“ – jumps to a dashboard, for example your garden page.
„Details einer Entität“ öffnet das Fenst: “Entity details” opens a device's dialog from Home Assistant, for example the living room blind.
“Call a service” runs a service. Below go its data in JSON format, for example which script should run.
Und „fire-dom-event“ öffnet zusammen mit: And fire-dom-event, together with browser_mod, opens a popup with your own card – for example all blinds at a glance.
Für meinen Gartenknopf bleibe ich bei „S: For my garden button I stay with “Open a path”. The icon is a Material Design icon, here a flower.
Mit dem Pfeil wandert ein Knopf nach obe: The arrow moves a button up, Delete – „Löschen“ – removes it.
In der 3D-Ansicht öffnet der Stern jetzt: In the 3D view the star now opens the favourites and below them your own buttons – with my new garden button.
Ganz unten bei den Favoriten stehen noch: At the very bottom of the favourites there are also stations and playlists. They belong to the Pro add-on Sound & Cinema.
Ist der Grundriss fertig, sperrst du ihn: Once the floor plan is done, you lock it: at the top of the toolbar, “Floor plan” with the lock – „Grundriss“.
Dann lassen sich Räume, Wände, Türen, Fe: Then rooms, walls, doors, windows and outdoor areas can no longer be moved by accident – not even newly drawn ones.
Ziehen auf einem Raum bewegt jetzt nur d: Dragging on a room now only moves the view. Selecting and changing things in the form still works.
Der Raum zeigt „Grundriss gesperrt“ – ei: The room shows “Floor plan locked” – one click on it unlocks again. A right-click on a room does it too.
Möbel und Geräte bleiben frei. Die fixie: Furniture and devices stay free. You fix them one by one with the lock in the form or with the L key – like in episode 4.
Zwei Dinge stehen woanders: Das Grundris: Two things live elsewhere: the floor plan picture under Template – „Vorlage“ – you know from episode 2.
Und die Sensoren für Netz, Solar und Akk: And the sensors for grid, solar and battery go into the Energy tool – „Energie“ – there is an episode of its own for that.
Die Sprache stellst du nicht hier ein: N: You don't set the language here: NeonPlan follows your profile in Home Assistant.
Kurz zusammengefasst: Wände, Raster, Nor: In short: walls, grid, north, roof, weather, start view, favourites and your own buttons – all at the bottom of the editor's sidebar.
In Teil 2 sicherst du deinen Plan und zi: In part 2 you back up your plan and move it to a new Home Assistant.
Links zur Online-Demo und zur Anleitung: Links to the online demo and the manual are in the description. And NeonPlan 3D also runs on old wall tablets. See you in part 2!
